subject: International Convention for the Control and Management of Ships' Ballast Water and Sediments, 2004 (BWM Convention)
label: IN FORCE — D-2 IMPLEMENTATION SCHEDULE COMPLETE — MEPC 84 AMENDMENT PACKAGE APPROVED, NOT ADOPTED

status_detail.entry_into_force_condition: Article 18(1): twelve months after not less than thirty States, with combined merchant fleets of not less than thirty-five per cent of world gross tonnage, have become Parties
status_detail.d2_deadline_basis: Regulation B-3.8 as amended by resolution MEPC.297(72): D-2 from the date decided by the Administration, but not later than 8 September 2024
status_detail.mepc84_amendment_package: APPROVED (MEPC 84, 27 April-1 May 2026), following the experience-building phase review; NOT ADOPTED
status_detail.mepc84_g4_guidelines: Revised Guidelines for ballast water management and development of Ballast Water Management Plans (G4) ADOPTED at MEPC 84

authority: IMO Status of Treaties, 2026 Vol. II, as at 30 September 2026, BWM 2004 (pp. 360-365)
Resolution MEPC.297(72), amendments to regulation B-3 (adopted 13 April 2018)

history.event: MEPC.297(72) adopts the revised B-3 implementation schedule
Latest date for existing ships to meet D-2 under regulation B-3.8
MEPC 84 (27 April-1 May 2026) approves a package of BWM Convention amendments after the experience-building phase review and adopts revised G4 guidelines

next_decision_or_trigger: Adoption of the BWM amendment package approved at MEPC 84, at a future MEPC session. The session and the entry-into-force date were not confirmed at primary source on the as_of date.
